title: Carry-Out Access Multiplier for Shared Buildings (Water Damage Mitigation)
content:
Water Damage Mitigation rate note on access. Carrying removed flooring out of a shared building sets an access multiplier on the per-load rate of the job's tear-out debris haul-off line:
- 1.2 for a condo unit or multifamily unit whose removed flooring area is above zero;
- 1.1 for a commercial property whose removed flooring area is above zero;
- in any other case no access multiplier applies.

The removed flooring area is the total square feet on the job's pad removal and carpet removal lines; the property type is the one recorded on the job.

## Condition table
| Property type on the job record | Removed flooring area | Access multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| condo unit | above zero | 1.2 |
| multifamily unit | above zero | 1.2 |
| commercial | above zero | 1.1 |
| condo unit, multifamily unit or commercial | zero (no pad or carpet removal lines) | none |
| single-family home or any other type | any | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical)
A third-floor condo unit whose job carries 520 square feet of carpet removal has its per-load rate multiplied by 1.2. The same unit with only flood cut lines and no pad or carpet removal carries no access multiplier.
